title: Kiosk mode (panel)
caption: Turn this device into a wall panel: one dashboard, no navigation, auto-return and screen-dim on idle.
idleReturnHelp: Seconds of inactivity before returning to the pinned screen (0 = never).
dimHelp: Seconds of inactivity before dimming the screen (0 = never). A tap wakes it.
exitHint: Exit kiosk with a long-press (2s) in the top-left corner.

exitConfirm.title: Exit kiosk mode?
exitConfirm.body: The panel returns to the normal UI with navigation.
